title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Technician Labor Rate Card
content:
## Rates in force by program

Labor on a demand call under the Demand Service Rate Programs is priced from the figures below. The
regular labor rate is the rate billed for one technician in regular hours. The after-hours, weekend and
holiday figures are the multipliers on that labor rate for work outside regular hours, for work on a
Saturday or Sunday, and for work on a published office holiday. The apprentice rate is the rate billed
for an apprentice accompanying the lead technician, and the second journeyman rate the rate billed for a
second journeyman on the same call.

| Program | Regular labor rate (USD per hour) | After-hours multiplier | Weekend multiplier | Holiday multiplier | Apprentice rate (USD per hour) | Second journeyman rate (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 165 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 2 | 92 | 155 |
| Priority Response Program | 152 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 2 | 88 | 144 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 144 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 84 | 138 |
| Emergency Response Program | 138 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.5 | 80 | 132 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 132 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.5 | 78 | 126 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 126 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.5 | 74 | 120 |

## Minimums and travel

The minimum billable hours are the least labor hours billed on any dispatched call in regular hours, and
the after-hours minimum the least billed on a call taken outside regular hours; both are stated in
decimal hours. The travel column states whether travel time to and from the site is billed as labor
under that program.

| Program | Minimum billable hours | After-hours minimum hours | Travel time billed as labor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 2 | 4 | Yes |
| Priority Response Program | 2 | 4 | No |
| Block Hour Service Program | 1.5 | 3 | No |
| Emergency Response Program | 1.5 | 2 | No |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 1 | 2 | No |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 1 | 2 | No |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A multiplier on this card acts on that same program's regular labor rate. On the Priority Response
Program an hour carrying the after-hours multiplier of 1.5 is therefore priced at 152 US dollars
multiplied by 1.5, which is 228 US dollars for that hour; the same hour on the Dedicated Technician
Program, where the multiplier is 1.25 and the regular rate 126 US dollars, is priced at 157.50 US
dollars. The figures are worked here only to show how the card is read.
